newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Malaysia sets Sept Tapis crude at $23.01 a barrel.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia sets Sept Tapis crude at $23.01 a barrel.

text.p: Malaysian state oil company Petronas increased the September lifting Tapis crude oil term price to $23.01 from $21.19 in August, traders said on Friday.
For October, Petronas set a premium of 55 cents per barrel for term crude oil sales, up from 40 cents in September.
Fixed differentials against Tapis for other Malaysian grades Labuan and Miri were unchanged, with Labuan 10 cents above Tapis, Miri 10 cents below Tapis and Bintulu 30 cents below Tapis.
The price of September Dulang was fixed at $22.11 per barrel against $20.38 in August.
Terengganu condensate was set at $21.81 per barrel for September, up from $19.99 in August.
Bintulu condensate was set at $21.91 for September, up from $20.09 in August.
SEPT AUGUST JULY JUNE MAY APRIL MARCH
